main_body: A tall, thin lamp post: a dark grey pole with a horizontal crossbar at the top carrying two hanging yellow lanterns, standing on a small grey stone base at the bottom.
top_band: none. At x=12 the column reads dark outline rows 3-4, then a uniform dark pole (L~37-42) from rows 5-31. There is no lighter top surface. The only light rows are at the base (rows 32-38).
evidence: The post is a 2px-wide vertical pole with a thin 1-2px crossbar on top, drawn straight from the front. The crossbar is a flat, dark line, with no lighter top surface and no ellipse or plate wider than the shaft. This matches the red 'flat band cap' and 'rim only' cases in the guide. The lanterns are small details and cannot supply a top. The stone base at the bottom has some light rows (32-38), but it is a small plinth and does not count as the main body's top. Under the column rule, the top must be a lighter face of at least 4 rows, and none exists here.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 17 distinct colours, against 38-40 in the references. The measured facts show 99% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% in the references, so the outline is a neutral near-black/grey line, which is the sticker look. The pole is a thin, uniformly dark grey stripe with almost no shading. The lanterns have two or three yellow tones, and the base has a few greys. The references carry richer material ramps with grain and tinted outlines. The candidate is thinner and flatter than either reference. Its 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0% only because the shapes are so thin, not because they are textured.
